new.en: The agent can now stop, resume and archive the conversations it started, and wait for them without ending its turn as if done.
new.pt-BR: O agente agora pode parar, retomar e arquivar as conversas que iniciou, e esperar por elas sem encerrar a sua vez como pronto.
new.es: El agente ahora puede detener, reanudar y archivar las conversaciones que inició, y esperar por ellas sin cerrar su turno como terminado.
new.fr: L’agent peut désormais arrêter, reprendre et archiver les conversations qu’il a lancées, et les attendre sans clore son tour comme terminé.
new.de: Der Agent kann von ihm gestartete Unterhaltungen jetzt stoppen, fortsetzen und archivieren sowie auf sie warten, ohne seinen Zug als fertig zu beenden.

better.en: When starting a conversation, the agent can now choose the AI, model and effort.
better.pt-BR: Ao iniciar uma conversa, o agente agora pode escolher a IA, o modelo e o esforço.
better.es: Al iniciar una conversación, el agente ahora puede elegir la IA, el modelo y el esfuerzo.
better.fr: Au lancement d’une conversation, l’agent peut désormais choisir l’IA, le modèle et l’effort.
better.de: Beim Starten einer Unterhaltung kann der Agent jetzt die KI, das Modell und den Aufwand wählen.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-31 | An AI acts only on the conversations it started (`started_by` chain, transitively; never itself, never its parent, and never the person's own conversations), a stricter boundary than the host's family reach: `stop`, `resume`, `archive` of another conversation and `wait` apply to these owned conversations only, while reading stays free. | AI (owner delegated) |

| R-next-2 | 2026-10-31 | An AI never uses `send`: host callers that are an agent get `error.session.useSession`. Instead, an AI starts and messages through session commands (`start_conversation`, `message_conversation`, `resume_conversation`) so every conversation it opens is linked and counted and every message it writes is labelled (`wake.asked`). | AI (owner delegated) |

| R-next-3 | 2026-10-31 | `wait` (`mark_waiting`) records that a conversation waits on listed child conversations (`waiting_on`) instead of ending its turn as if done. The marker clears when a listed conversation reports to its parent (`tell_parent`), at the asker's next turn start, or when archived; while set, the conversation reads as `waiting`, Keep going sends no prod turns, and auto-archive spares it. | AI (owner delegated) |

| R-next-4 | 2026-10-31 | In the shared command table, `archive` moves from `free` to `own` (`Reach::Own("/id")`): an AI caller may archive only conversations within its family, and the engine narrows that to conversations it started. Unarchive (`on: false`) from an AI is refused. | AI (owner delegated) |
